_comment: Source of truth for the built-in service icons. Regenerate with `make service-icons`.
The map key is the SERVICE TEMPLATE KEY, and the generated file is named after it
(google_calendar.svg, not googlecalendar.svg). That is what lets a template omit
`icon:` entirely and still resolve to `builtin:<key>` — see DECISIONS.md.
simple-icons:<slug>  copied from the pinned simple-icons package; owner/guidelines
metadata is read from the package and folded into NOTICE.md
pending              no asset shipped. The template falls back to the letter tile.
Requires `owner`, `guidelines` and `note` so the gap is legible.
`client_*` keys are not service templates: they are MCP client marks, used to give an
agent the icon of the client it is bound to (see DECISIONS.md D68). The prefix keeps them
out of the implicit `builtin:<template key>` rule, so a service template keyed `cursor`
could never silently inherit the Cursor client mark. `client_unknown` is the generic bot
every unrecognised client falls back to.

client_chatgpt.note: No OpenAI mark in simple-icons. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.

client_unknown.note: Generic bot glyph authored by us. Not a vendor mark. The fallback for an agent whose MCP client we do not recognise, or that has no MCP binding at all.

client_vscode.note: No Microsoft marks in simple-icons. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.

deepwiki.note: Generic wiki glyph authored by us. DeepWiki has no mark in simple-icons and we do not ship theirs.

email.note: Generic envelope glyph authored by us. Not a vendor mark.

eventbrite.note: No simple-icons entry. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.

http.note: Generic globe glyph authored by us. Mode A is not a vendor — this stands for "any URL you supply", which is what the pseudo-service is.

linkedin.note: Removed from simple-icons at the brand's request. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.

outlook.note: No Microsoft marks in simple-icons. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.

overslash.note: Our own mark, derived from the dashboard logo.

slack.note: Removed from simple-icons at the brand's request. Source from the vendor brand page before shipping.

test_email.note: Generic envelope glyph authored by us. Not a vendor mark.
